exposure: Subset of patients receiving prenatal care at the institution
outcome: proportion of visits for hypertensive disease
cohort: 648 patients presenting to the obstetric triage unit at a tertiary care center from March through April 2014
finding: While frequent obstetric triage visits were not associated with an increased risk of preterm birth, they were associated with an increased risk of cesarean delivery.
mod_finding: Patients with frequent obstetric triage visits had an increased risk of cesarean delivery compared to those with fewer visits.
